documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Upcoming Board Meeting Of The Company.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations growing by 60% year-on-year to INR 121 crores and EBITDA increasing by 39% to INR 18 crores. Management highlighted robust consumer demand across both wholesale and retail segments, alongside store expansion plans including the upcoming launch of four stores in Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar. The company is strategically progressing toward a 50-50 B2B and retail revenue mix in the medium term, while exploring gold metal loans for inventory hedging and improved debt leverage. Furthermore, the management emphasized building brand robustness and scaling retail operations to capture future franchise opportunities. RBZ Jewellers reported strong performance for Q1 FY27, with operational revenue increasing by approximately 60% year-on-year to INR 1,208 million and EBITDA reaching INR 180 million.

guidance.claim: The company targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
guidance.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand outlook for the second quarter appears good and promising.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that IIJS was very warm, encouraging, and yielded buyer growth and good order backing.
demand_outlook.quote: So IIJS has been really warm this time, like it was really good this time. It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing.

demand_outlook.claim: The company reported that corporate order kitties for July and August are full.
demand_outlook.quote: because of which the July, August order kitty are full.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue increased by approximately 60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they continue to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that Surat will launch in Quarter 2 and Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores have a carpet area of around 10,000 square feet and mid format stores around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in small format stores is around INR 50 crores, plus or minus 10% to 15%.
capex_expansion.quote: While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities like Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations for the quarter stood at INR 121 crores, registering a growth of 60% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter under review, revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores registering a strong growth of 60% Y-o-Y with a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR 18 crores with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 9 crores, translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Retail revenue stood at INR 78 crores, registering a 70% year-on-year growth, and wholesale revenue stood at 42% reflecting a 47% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: In terms of segmental performance for the quarter, retail revenue stood at INR78 crores registering a robust 70% Y-o-Y growth. Wholesale revenue stood at 42% reflecting a strong 47% Y-o-Y growth.

margins_costs.claim: The amortization of lease assets is INR 76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR 115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now. So, on the Quarter 1 side the EBITDA margins have reflected that. There is other two impacts that are there: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 14.9%.
For the full year FY26, EBITDA margins improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that retail gross margins are around 12% to 14%, wholesale gross margins around 7% to 8%, and B2B around 6% to 7% and 8%.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, retail would be around 12% or 14% GP. Wholesale will be around 7% to 8% GP. B2B will be around 6% to 7% and 8% GP.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that total factory capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that factory utilization is currently around 50% of capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio,

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for FY26 is approximately 50% or 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company has a sanctioned debt of around INR 300 crores which is yet to be utilized.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that by the end of the financial year, the debt-to-equity ratio will still be below 1:1, specifically around 0.8 debt to 1 equity.
capital_allocation.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that restrictions such as customs duty and advanced authorization on gold imports are not advantageous, though the exact impact on the industry needs time to be understood.
risks_headwinds.quote: Certainly, I think these restrictions are not advantageous, but up to what level there is an impact is crucial.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that capex break-even for the stores will be achieved in a year or less.
management_commitments.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and 75-25 in the long term with retail being 75%.
management_commitments.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that by the end of this year, at least 20% of corporate sales mix will be of 18 caratage.
management_commitments.quote: I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the transition to completely churn over the whole inventory to be hedged using Gold Metal Loan will take three years of time.
management_commitments.quote: as and when the quarter passes we want to completely churn over the whole inventory to go hedged. But that will take three year of time that I, as you have said.

management_commitments.claim: The company targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The third and fourth store openings are planned within this calendar year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
